summary: Find the bounding box of the input color-7 glyph. Its width plus one and height plus one define a lattice. Repeat the glyph across every horizontal instance in the first lattice row; recolor instances 2, 5, 8, ... to color 6 and repeat only those color-6 instance columns down later lattice rows. Clear every other cell.
